meta.title: Light Eclipsing Shadow
meta.description: At the edge of the impossible, draw up a brand new blueprint.

units.rawText: When I open my eyes again, my mind is adrift in an endless data domain.
units.displayText: When I open my eyes again, my mind is adrift in an endless data domain.

spans.text: When I open my eyes again, my mind is adrift in an endless data domain.

units.rawText: I can hear my heartbeat and a whining in my ears... I can't tell which direction is which by the scenery around me, but I know I have to keep moving forward.
units.displayText: I can hear my heartbeat and a whining in my ears... I can't tell which direction is which by the scenery around me, but I know I have to keep moving forward.

spans.text: I can hear my heartbeat and a whining in my ears... I can't tell which direction is which by the scenery around me, but I know I have to keep moving forward.

units.rawText: The sound of mocking laughter reaches my ears through the darkness. It feels as though the gods are watching me act out a comedy from above, rating and dissecting every single move I make.
units.displayText: The sound of mocking laughter reaches my ears through the darkness. It feels as though the gods are watching me act out a comedy from above, rating and dissecting every single move I make.

spans.text: The sound of mocking laughter reaches my ears through the darkness. It feels as though the gods are watching me act out a comedy from above, rating and dissecting every single move I make.

units.rawText: Why are you trying so hard? They're just data.
units.displayText: Why are you trying so hard? They're just data.

spans.text: Why are you trying so hard? They're just data.

units.rawText: Aren't you used to abandoning and sacrificing pawns by now?
units.displayText: Aren't you used to abandoning and sacrificing pawns by now?

spans.text: Aren't you used to abandoning and sacrificing pawns by now?

units.rawText: Countless data fragments dance wildly through the air, twinkling like razor-sharp glass fragments. They form an impenetrable web, slowly slicing away at my limbs and body.
units.displayText: Countless data fragments dance wildly through the air, twinkling like razor-sharp glass fragments. They form an impenetrable web, slowly slicing away at my limbs and body.

spans.text: Countless data fragments dance wildly through the air, twinkling like razor-sharp glass fragments. They form an impenetrable web, slowly slicing away at my limbs and body.

units.rawText: Guh!
units.displayText: Guh!

spans.text: Guh!

units.rawText: The hacking attacks are unceasing, taking the form of sharp swords advancing on me as a horde. They mercilessly slash and stab at my body.
units.displayText: The hacking attacks are unceasing, taking the form of sharp swords advancing on me as a horde. They mercilessly slash and stab at my body.

spans.text: The hacking attacks are unceasing, taking the form of sharp swords advancing on me as a horde. They mercilessly slash and stab at my body.

units.rawText: Gwaaaargh—
units.displayText: Gwaaaargh—

spans.text: Gwaaaargh—

units.rawText: I, I can't go down... I will not go down here...
units.displayText: I, I can't go down... I will not go down here...

spans.text: I, I can't go down... I will not go down here...

units.rawText: Everyone helped block this damage for me in Eosphorus' neural cloud... So now... let me...
units.displayText: Everyone helped block this damage for me in Eosphorus' neural cloud... So now... let me...

spans.text: Everyone helped block this damage for me in Eosphorus' neural cloud... So now... let me...

units.rawText: My consciousness gradually fades away and the voices in my ears grow more pressing.
units.displayText: My consciousness gradually fades away and the voices in my ears grow more pressing.

spans.text: My consciousness gradually fades away and the voices in my ears grow more pressing.

units.rawText: You should know that what you're doing now is pointless.
units.displayText: You should know that what you're doing now is pointless.

spans.text: You should know that what you're doing now is pointless.

units.rawText: There is no such thing as a perfect ending in this world. All you're doing now is just a form of self-gratification. There is no way to change the outcome that has already been decided.
units.displayText: There is no such thing as a perfect ending in this world. All you're doing now is just a form of self-gratification. There is no way to change the outcome that has already been decided.

spans.text: There is no such thing as a perfect ending in this world. All you're doing now is just a form of self-gratification. There is no way to change the outcome that has already been decided.

units.rawText: Is it worth going through all this for that data? They're nothing more than outdated scraps of code. The world won't be affected if they're gone.
units.displayText: Is it worth going through all this for that data? They're nothing more than outdated scraps of code. The world won't be affected if they're gone.

spans.text: Is it worth going through all this for that data? They're nothing more than outdated scraps of code. The world won't be affected if they're gone.

units.rawText: They can be deleted and rewritten at any time as long as humans will it.
units.displayText: They can be deleted and rewritten at any time as long as humans will it.

spans.text: They can be deleted and rewritten at any time as long as humans will it.

units.rawText: There's a limit to how long you can spend with anyone or anything. There'll always be something new to fill the gap.
units.displayText: There's a limit to how long you can spend with anyone or anything. There'll always be something new to fill the gap.

spans.text: There's a limit to how long you can spend with anyone or anything. There'll always be something new to fill the gap.

units.rawText: Go on, admit it. Humans love the novel, and so do you.
units.displayText: Go on, admit it. Humans love the novel, and so do you.

spans.text: Go on, admit it. Humans love the novel, and so do you.

units.rawText: Just forget everything, and it will be easier for you. Don't be so stubborn any more...
units.displayText: Just forget everything, and it will be easier for you. Don't be so stubborn any more...

spans.text: Just forget everything, and it will be easier for you. Don't be so stubborn any more...

units.rawText: Crimson operands drip from my body and spray through the air.
units.displayText: Crimson operands drip from my body and spray through the air.

spans.text: Crimson operands drip from my body and spray through the air.

units.rawText: Pain has long since numbed my nerves, and my body is reaching its limit.
units.displayText: Pain has long since numbed my nerves, and my body is reaching its limit.

spans.text: Pain has long since numbed my nerves, and my body is reaching its limit.

units.rawText: Nobody will praise you for this.
units.displayText: Nobody will praise you for this.

spans.text: Nobody will praise you for this.

units.rawText: Your efforts exist in a vacuum. All you are doing is struggling pointlessly for the sake of those memories which are about to fade.
units.displayText: Your efforts exist in a vacuum. All you are doing is struggling pointlessly for the sake of those memories which are about to fade.

spans.text: Your efforts exist in a vacuum. All you are doing is struggling pointlessly for the sake of those memories which are about to fade.

units.rawText: Shut up...
units.displayText: Shut up...

spans.text: Shut up...

units.rawText: So just go back.
units.displayText: So just go back.

spans.text: So just go back.

units.rawText: Nobody will know the lengths to which you have gone here. In the end, all you have done is chosen to cover yourself in wounds.
units.displayText: Nobody will know the lengths to which you have gone here. In the end, all you have done is chosen to cover yourself in wounds.

spans.text: Nobody will know the lengths to which you have gone here. In the end, all you have done is chosen to cover yourself in wounds.

units.rawText: ...I know... What I'm doing.
units.displayText: ...I know... What I'm doing.

spans.text: ...I know... What I'm doing.

units.rawText: If you say that, then you know what awaits you at the end of this road, right?
units.displayText: If you say that, then you know what awaits you at the end of this road, right?

spans.text: If you say that, then you know what awaits you at the end of this road, right?

units.rawText: Giving up is the only sensible option left for you.
units.displayText: Giving up is the only sensible option left for you.

spans.text: Giving up is the only sensible option left for you.

units.rawText: After all... nobody even cares, right?
units.displayText: After all... nobody even cares, right?

spans.text: After all... nobody even
cares
, right?
Even so...
She will care.

options.rawText: Everyone waiting for me will care.
options.displayText: Everyone waiting for me will care.

spans.text: Everyone waiting for me will care.

options.rawText: I will... take back Magrasea's future...
options.displayText: I will... take back Magrasea's future...

spans.text: I will... take back Magrasea's future...
After all...
I am... the Oasis' Professor...

units.rawText: ...You idiot, you make me sick.
units.displayText: ...You idiot, you make me sick.

spans.text: ...You idiot, you make me sick.

units.rawText: ...Still, I do somewhat envy you.
units.displayText: ...Still, I do somewhat envy you.

spans.text: ...Still, I do somewhat envy you.

units.rawText: Let them be. Don't forget, Commander... reality is where we shall compete...
units.displayText: Let them be. Don't forget, Commander... reality is where we shall compete...

spans.text: Let them be. Don't forget, Commander... reality is where we shall compete...

units.rawText: The mocking laughter instantly vanishes and the data turbulence suddenly recedes. The clamor of the virtual world abruptly goes silent.
units.displayText: The mocking laughter instantly vanishes and the data turbulence suddenly recedes. The clamor of the virtual world abruptly goes silent.

spans.text: The mocking laughter instantly vanishes and the data turbulence suddenly recedes. The clamor of the virtual world abruptly goes silent.

units.rawText: There is a faint light at the end of the darkness.
units.displayText: There is a faint light at the end of the darkness.

spans.text: There is a faint light at the end of the darkness.

units.rawText: ...The cloud... new server...
units.displayText: ...The cloud... new server...

spans.text: ...The cloud... new server...

units.rawText: Magrasea's future...
units.displayText: Magrasea's future...

spans.text: Magrasea's future...

units.rawText: All my sacrifices are validated by this moment. Destiny has finally smiled upon me.
units.displayText: All my sacrifices are validated by this moment. Destiny has finally smiled upon me.

spans.text: All my sacrifices are validated by this moment. Destiny has finally smiled upon me.

units.rawText: With my last bit of strength, I make contact with the cold, hard firewall of the server.
units.displayText: With my last bit of strength, I make contact with the cold, hard firewall of the server.

spans.text: With my last bit of strength, I make contact with the cold, hard firewall of the server.

units.rawText: I've worn this pin for a long time.
units.displayText: I've worn this pin for a long time.

spans.text: I've worn this pin for a long time.

units.rawText: I've kept it by my side in the Oasis and in reality. It's something like a lucky charm for me.
units.displayText: I've kept it by my side in the Oasis and in reality. It's something like a lucky charm for me.

spans.text: I've kept it by my side in the Oasis and in reality. It's something like a lucky charm for me.

units.rawText: ...I hope that when you see it, you'll think of us and remember the time you spent with us in Magrasea.
units.displayText: ...I hope that when you see it, you'll think of us and remember the time you spent with us in Magrasea.

spans.text: ...I hope that when you see it, you'll think of us and remember the time you spent with us in Magrasea.

units.rawText: If anything happy or annoying happens, feel free to let it know. Perhaps those feelings will convey your voice to us...
units.displayText: If anything happy or annoying happens, feel free to let it know. Perhaps those feelings will convey your voice to us...

spans.text: If anything happy or annoying happens, feel free to let it know. Perhaps those feelings will convey your voice to us...

units.rawText: My ruined body sprawls against the invisible barrier. My hands are a mass of blood and meat as they carefully pull out the pin from my pocket and speak to it, saying the first words that come to mind.
units.displayText: My ruined body sprawls against the invisible barrier. My hands are a mass of blood and meat as they carefully pull out the pin from my pocket and speak to it, saying the first words that come to mind.

spans.text: My ruined body sprawls against the invisible barrier. My hands are a mass of blood and meat as they carefully pull out the pin from my pocket and speak to it, saying the first words that come to mind.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Persicaria... I came through... on my end...</color>
units.displayText: Persicaria... I came through... on my end...

spans.text: Persicaria... I came through... on my end...

units.rawText: <color=orange>So make sure you're there for me...</color>
units.displayText: So make sure you're there for me...

spans.text: So make sure you're there for me...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Everyone...</color>
units.displayText: Everyone...

spans.text: Everyone...
